cohort: 2499 women undergoing singleton cesarean sections at a public tertiary hospital in Australia from 2008 to 2010
finding: While carbetocin did not significantly reduce the incidence of PPH ≥1000 mL, it was associated with a reduction in moderate blood loss >500 mL and a 20% reduction in the need for secondary uterotonic treatment.
mod_finding: This study found that carbetocin reduced moderate blood loss during caesarean section but not postpartum hemorrhage.
